t: This is the site of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion from 2005, a temporary building that has since been taken down. It was designed by two Portuguese architects, Álvaro Siza Vieira and Eduardo Souto de Moura. Both come from the Porto School of Architecture. Souto de Moura went on to win the Pritzker Architecture Prize in 2011 and the Wolf Prize in Arts in 2013. Siza is one of the best-known names to come out of that same school, so this was a collaboration between two of its leading figures.
